title: 到底是誰先說的
genre: Mandarin original musical theatre show tune
subject: a couple holding ticket 147 in the marriage registry queue, still arguing over which of them said 'I like you' first
caption: Chinese-language original musical theatre show tune, a comic duet in the Shanghai small-theatre style. A pit orchestra led by piano; a string section underscoring the recitative; clarinet and flute trading quick answering figures between the two singers; a French horn swelling under the last chorus and timpani hits on each dramatic turn; a light kit played with brushes that drops out for the recitative and for the slower final chorus. Clear and theatrical, roomy like a small playhouse, both voices forward with crisp diction. A male baritone and a female mezzo-soprano with legit theatre tone opening into belt, arguing in sung recitative, trading lines, and ending together on one long held note. 108 BPM, E-flat major. Bickering and completely in love. No pop ballad, no drum machine, no rap, no TV-drama string pad, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, piano vamp, pizzicato strings ticking like a queue display]

[Verse 1 - Female, sung recitative]
一百四十七號 前面還有十二對
說好穿白襯衫 你怎麼穿了格子的
戶口本 身份證 三張兩吋的合照
你把袋子抱在胸口 好像抱著一隻貓

[Pre-Chorus - Male, strings rise]
妳還記得嗎 那年在公司樓下
是妳先跑來問我 要不要一起拼外賣

[Chorus - Duet, brushes enter]
到底是誰先說的
是你 (是妳) 是你 (是妳)
那天停電 我們卡在電梯裡
黑暗裡有一個人 小聲說了喜歡

[Verse 2 - Male, Female, Male, trading lines]
是妳 那時候妳的聲音在發抖
是你 你抖到整台電梯都在晃
那是電梯 它自己在晃

[Chorus - Duet]
到底是誰先說的
是你 (是妳) 是你 (是妳)
吵了三年 誰也不認輸
今天就去問 那個蓋章的人

[Bridge - both voices half-spoken over timpani, then the horn swells]
三號窗口的阿姨抬頭問 你們是自願的嗎

[Chorus - Duet, full strings and horn, slower, ending on one long held note]
到底是誰先說的
這一次 我們同時說了 是
蓋章的阿姨笑了 好 那就不用吵了
是——

[Outro - piano alone, one last pizzicato tick; Male, then Female]
剛剛那一聲 是我先說的
才怪
